title: Concept: Service account token auto-mounted via automountServiceAccountToken: true (k8s) — review required
description: With automountServiceAccountToken: true in effect, every container in the pod receives a bearer token for the service account. A dependency compromise or command injection therefore gains the account’s RBAC rights without any further step. Disable the mount when the pod does not call the API, and prefer a projected token with a narrow audience (a projected token with a restricted audience).
applicability: Kubernetes pod, deployment and service account manifests; lexical scope.
risk: API privilege escalation from a compromised container; MEDIUM severity.
